facts.name: Peter F. Estrada
facts.assignment: Highlands juvenile/probate/guardianship/mental/risk protection, SectionJR as listed.

contact.contact_note: Shared office/assistant number; personal judicial email not established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Email case/motion details and time estimate, copying attorneys; coordinate and wait for assistant confirmation before noticing. Notify office of cancellations.

proposed_orders.summary: Linked order sheet permits Word orders by email or e-file and requires CAPS compliance with cited administrative order. Filing with clerk does not itself present matter to judge.

courtesy_copies.summary: Procedure sheet directs documents/packets to office one week before hearing; original documents go to clerk, not chambers.

remote_appearances.summary: General sheet permits many short hearings by Teams and requires motion for virtual attendance at an in-person hearing. Procedure sheet separately gives video and telephone instructions; preserve the telephone conflict.

chambers_communications.summary: Use assistant email for office requests, copy attorneys and avoid substantive ex parte communications; staff cannot provide legal advice.

facts.summary: Practical office routes for this mixed probate/noncivil assignment: email scheduling, confirmed notices, Word orders, clerk filing and Teams appearance guidance.

review_scope.collected: Profile, general2pages, procedures1page and orders1page originals.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Contacts/assignment and basic scheduling, filing, proposed-order, communications and appearance routes; no probate merits or noncivil substantive analysis.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Specialized probate requirements and individual motion/continuance standards; administrative-order content deferred to shared county reconciliation.

conflicts.statement: General information says telephonic appearances are not currently allowed; procedures sheet expressly provides a call-in number/ID. Both preserved without selecting a controlling instruction.
Profile lists SectionJR; order sheet uses Section10-Civil as an example. Example is preserved and not treated as assignment evidence.

gaps: Personal judicial email, separate assistant-only number and revision dates not stated.
